propositions: A new mcp compose service must run rebar-mcp HTTP on loopback 127.0.0.1:8091 with restart:always, healthcheck hitting /health, and stop_grace_period of 1260s to cover 1200s app SIGTERM grace.

The /health endpoint must expose an integer in_flight gauge counting only certified ops (review_plan/verify_completion/review_code/scan_spec) and return 200 without authentication even when REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1.
nginx /mcp/ location must proxy to a named upstream rebar_mcp sourced from materialized mcp-upstream*.conf files, enabling atomic blue-green upstream flips by rewriting the file and reloading nginx.
The SIGTERM grace handler must wait up to 1200s for in_flight to reach 0 before exiting, with compose stop_grace_period of 1260s ensuring Docker never SIGKILLs mid-operation.
Fail-closed HTTP posture requires env config for REBAR_MCP_HTTP_TLS_AT_EDGE=true and REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS/ALLOWED_ORIGINS, raising McpStartupError if non-loopback bind lacks these acks.
materialize-mcp-upstream.sh must idempotently install the committed seed to /etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf only-if-absent on fresh boot, called from compose-up.sh before docker compose up.
